blocks.task_summary: Find constants a, b, c in the rational function using three conditions: vertical asymptote x=1 gives a+b+c=0; point (2,1) gives 4a+2b+c=-2; local minimum at x=2 gives dy/dx=0 yielding 12a+4b+c=0. Solve the linear system to obtain a=3, b=-11, c=8.
method_path: Set denominator to zero at vertical asymptote x=1 to obtain a+b+c=0
Substitute point (2,1) into curve equation to obtain 4a+2b+c=-2
Differentiate using quotient rule to find dy/dx
Set numerator of derivative to zero at x=2 to obtain 12a+4b+c=0
Solve the system of three linear equations to find a=3, b=-11, c=8

evidence.basis: recognizes that x=1 implies ax^2+bx+c=0 (M1); a+b+c=0 (seen anywhere) A1
passes through (2,1) so: (4-2)/(4a+2b+c)=1 implies 2=4a+2b+c (seen anywhere) A1
attempts to find dy/dx using quotient or product rule M1; substitutes x=2 into numerator of dy/dx=0 (M1); (12a+4b+c)=0 A1
attempts to solve their 3 linear equations (M1); a=3, b=-11 and c=8 A1
